answer: The raven graph is rebuilt each epoch, as a result the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the comet audit merges it again. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the meadow checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 2 times its size, so a group of 97 keys loses far more than 97 single identities would. That is 32 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
